name: artistgrid-android
description: Unofficial Android app for ArtistGrid: browse and listen to unreleased music trackers.

scripts.build: cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:android: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: cap sync ios && cd ios/App && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO clean build
